Standard: For air vehicles where crewmembers are expected to manually fight fires, the following minimum number of handheld fire extinguishers are provided: a. At least one hand fire extinguisher is conveniently located in each occupied compartment. b. At least one readily accessible hand fire extinguisher is available for use in each cargo compartment that is accessible to crewmembers in flight. c. At least one hand fire extinguisher is located in, or readily accessible for use in each galley. d. For air vehicles with passenger compartment capacities greater than 30 passengers, the number of hand fire extinguishers are IAW the table in 14 CFR 25.851. e. Each hand fire extinguisher is approved for the types of fires and environment expected. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Conduct inspection of design drawings to show hand fire extinguishers are provided as IAW the standard to mitigate fire hazards in each location. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct analysis that shows the number and type of hand fire extinguishers in each compartment are capable of mitigating the predicted fire hazards in each area. Test.
    (1) Ground test: Conduct ground test that shows fire extinguishers are accessible and easily accessed by crewmembers and passengers in each area.
